description: Remove a connected account: POSTING TO THAT PLATFORM STOPS until it is reconnected, and this cannot be undone from here. Pass confirm: true only after the owner has agreed to disconnect that exact account; without it, this returns a preview and disconnects nothing. Needs the separate manage:accounts permission. Take the accountId from soclo_accounts_list.

accountId.description: The connected account id, from soclo_accounts_list. For X Ads connect: the owned X posting account id.

confirm.description: true only after the owner agreed. Omit or pass false to get a preview instead: nothing is changed.

name: soclo_accounts_disconnect
title: Disconnect a social account
